behaviour: Continuous A/D and analog horizontal steering, rather than a 90-degree target heading.
Maximum angular speed 100 degrees/second times input; exact exponential integration with 0.075-second time constant for acceleration/deceleration.
Short/long/half-strength input gives proportional rotation; 30/60/120Hz comparisons match after release.
Movement follows the current heading along a curve; W/S remain forward/backward. First/third camera optical heading matches the character.
Attack and dash commitments retain their direction; overhead movement and stored progression remain unchanged.
limitations: Chromium/SwiftShader with emulated mobile touch; physical Safari performance unmeasured.
